pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: crates/apps/crawl/src/lib.rs:1 The context crawls web pages and extracts records from HTML. A case-insensitive grep of crates/apps/crawl and crates/apps/extractor for speech, tts, microphone, audio and whisper found nothing, so no capture or synthesis pipeline exists for voice-io to govern.

pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: plugins-src/title-extractor/Cargo.toml:14 The plugins are wasm32 cdylibs that depend only on serde_json and implement a JSON extract/predicate ABI. Grepping plugins-src for speech, tts, microphone, audio and whisper found nothing; the only near-hit was the word 'transcribed' in a code comment, so there is no voice input or output.

pairs.subject: voice-io
pairs.evidence: crates/apps/watch/src/lib.rs:1 These apps fetch, fingerprint and aggregate web content. Grepping the hackernews, research, readable, watch, connector-api-watch, peer, provisioner and plugin crates for speech, tts, microphone, audio and whisper found nothing; 'synthesize' in research means LLM text synthesis, not speech.

pairs.subject: voice-io
